'''KesCorp''' was a research company created by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] which studied the medical applications of the [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]]. With the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], criminals took possession of the company.
